messages:
Alex P.: heads-up — Orion (legal already signed NDA) wants a 12mo dedicated commit. mixed GPU pool: 4xA100 + 8xA10s, target baseline 300 rps, with burst to 1k for weekly spikes. need pricing + deal-desk approval. any blockers?
Maria G.: rough sketch: list price for reserved pool = $X/month (will attach calc), burst rate = pay-as-you-go at 2.5x baseline token rate. can propose a limited introductory discount.
Jordan L.: technical — will the mixed pool support autoscale to 1k without massive cold-start latency? also which region? if cross-region, we may need separate pools or async fallback.
Alex P.: region: us-west + eu-west dual footprint, they'd prefer single billing. they asked for guaranteed burst SLA during business hours.
Priya (DealDesk): need the margin impact and rationale for any >20% discount. also include churn risk and reference POC success criteria. if >25% we need VP sales signoff.
Maria G.: attaching quick calc snippet (placeholder numbers):
```
reserved_monthly = 4*A100_rate + 8*A10_rate - commit_discount
expected_util = 0.6
burst_cost = (peak_tokens - baseline_tokens) * payg_rate
net_margin = reserved_monthly - infra_costs - burst_cost
```
Maria G.: recommendation: 20% on reserved monthly for 12mo + capped burst surcharge; free 2-week POC credits (dedicated) to validate.
Jordan L.: on autoscale: we can pre-warm with KV caches and quick ramp rules. operational note: burst above reserved uses burst pool with instance spin-up, expect 5-12s tail latencies for cold starts unless we reserve a small warm buffer.
Alex P.: customer asked for a hard cap on burst spend per month. propose a $15k/month burst cap and alert thresholds at 60/80/95%. ok?
Priya (DealDesk): cap is fine but we need to model worst-case payout. please add projected 95th pct usage and attach to the ticket. also we need a redline of contract terms for the billing paragraph.
pricing-bot: link to pricing matrix: https://redwood.example/pricing/dedicated-ratecard (version v2.3)
Maria G.: I'll update calc with 95pct spike and add the 3-month ramp discount clause. aiming to keep discount <=20% to avoid escalation.
Alex P.: I'll draft the customer-facing deal summary and include the POC success criteria (latency <200ms p50 during baseline, <1s p95 during burst).
Priya (DealDesk): please upload margin calc and draft terms to the deal ticket. if margin < 30% after burst modelling, escalate. otherwise I'll sign off and route to legal for T&C redline. :thumbsup:
Jordan L.: one more ask — ops needs a runbook for burst failover (route to smaller model fallback) during capacity saturation. adding to the POC checklist.
Alex P.: thanks — target to get internal approval by EOD tomorrow so we can send formal quote on Friday.
Maria G.: noted, will push calc and draft by EOD.
Priya (DealDesk): acked.
Alex P.: thanks all :rocket:
